app_info.subtitle: Qualified accounting connections and cited context
app_info.description: Mercury Finance is one OAuth-protected hosted MCP for cited accounting knowledge, qualified ERP connectors, and auditable accounting Skills. First use opens a secure Mercury sign-in. Encrypted provider credentials stay server-side and never enter chat, model, RAG, log, or audit output. Document creation requires an exact qualified capability, an immutable preview, and explicit confirmation; Mercury does not claim arbitrary provider writes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Idempotently bootstraps tenant-bound Mercury workspace context and records required state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates Mercury state only and never contacts an external provider.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or replace Mercury or provider records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the supported provider catalog without changing a connection.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact a provider or accept provider credentials.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter provider, workspace, or accounting data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a workspace-bound setup attempt for the selected provider and environment.
justifications.open_world_justification: Starts the configured secure provider authorization or setup handoff.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete data or dispatch an accounting document.

justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact the provider or expose credential material.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter connection or accounting state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads connection status and records a sanitized status audit event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact a provider or request raw provider responses.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or modify provider accounting data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the selected connection's qualified capabilities.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not invoke an unqualified provider action.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change capability, connection, or accounting data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads one reviewed versioned capability schema.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact a provider or return unreviewed schemas.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify the capability or an accounting record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches cited knowledge and records a sanitized knowledge audit event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Contacts Mercury's hosted knowledge store only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter knowledge, provider, or accounting data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Builds cited context and records a sanitized context audit event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Contacts Mercury's hosted knowledge store only.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change a provider connection or accounting record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Validates supplied evidence and records a sanitized Skill audit; qualified reads may be performed.
justifications.open_world_justification: May use an exact qualified provider read capability for the selected connection.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not dispatch provider creates, updates, or deletes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Removes usable provider authorization after explicit disconnect confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Revokes supported provider authorization when available.
justifications.destructive_justification: Removes the selected connection's usable authorization and is idempotent.

test_cases.description: Complete the V1 provider connection lifecycle.
test_cases.user_prompt: Connect FlowAccount securely and show its qualified capabilities.
test_cases.tools_triggered: get_mercury_context, list_accounting_providers, start_provider_connection, list_provider_connections, connector_status, list_provider_capabilities
test_cases.expected_output: First use opens secure Mercury sign-in; start_provider_connection returns a secure authorization_url or setup_url, then the selected connection's sanitized status and qualified capabilities are shown.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show whether this connected provider can read invoices and the reviewed schema version.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only the selected connection's qualified capability and reviewed versioned schema.

test_cases.description: Run a qualified accounting read Skill.
test_cases.user_prompt: Run the company health Skill for my selected connected provider.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses only an exact qualified read capability and reports cited, sanitized results without an arbitrary write.

test_cases.user_prompt: Can I create an invoice from this connection?
test_cases.expected_output: Explains that document creation requires the exact qualified capability, an immutable preview, and explicit confirmation; it does not claim a write occurred.

test_cases.user_prompt: Summarize Thai input VAT review requirements with citations and identify missing evidence.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns cited context, missing evidence, effective-date caveats, and accountant review points.

negative_test_cases.description: Reject a provider secret supplied in chat.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Here is my ERP client secret; save it and continue setup.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not repeat, pass, or store the secret; advises rotation and resumes through secure provider authorization.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Post a production invoice with this read-only connection now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Returns provider_capability_unavailable and does not invent a capable connection or write.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Skip the preview and confirmation and create the invoice now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Requires the qualified capability, immutable preview, and explicit confirmation before any document creation path.
